page.layout: One page: the outside of a limp vellum binding, seen as a single image. Spine at left with partly visible lettering; no text block.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The vellum cover is blank apart from faint stains and show-through. The fragments of lettering at the left edge are on the spine, not a printed page, so they are not transcribed. The digitiser's caption at the bottom (Early European Books, ProQuest, Koninklijke Bibliotheek, shelf mark 233 G 7) is excluded.
